ABKons.desc: An Albanian management consulting firm, Abkons Sh.p.k, founded in 2006, with 51-200 employees. Its services include engineering, environmental and social impact assessment, permitting, project management, and land easement and acquisition work, mainly in energy, natural resources, transport and urban development.

sources.title: Abkons Sh.p.k - organisation profile

ACWA Power.desc: A Saudi-listed company that develops and operates power generation and water desalination plants, and which describes itself as the world's largest private water desalination company. It reported 69.2 GW of gross power generation capacity at the end of 2024 and net profit of SAR 1,757 million attributable to shareholders for that year.

sources.title: ACWA Power announces its financial results for the full year ended 31 December 2024

AD Hydro Power Limited.desc: An Indian power company set up to build, own and operate a 192 MW run-of-the-river hydroelectric plant in Kullu District, Himachal Pradesh. It is jointly owned by Rajasthan Spinning & Weaving Mills Limited, HEG Limited and Malana Power Company Limited.

sources.title: AD Hydro Power Limited - Summary of Proposed Investment

AES Changuinola (AES Corporation).desc: A Panamanian hydroelectric generating company, constituted in Panama on 21 November 2001 as Hydro Teribe, S.A. and converted to a limited liability company (S.R.L.) in September 2014. It owns the 223 MW Changuinola I plant and sells all its output to its affiliate AES Panama; AES Bocas del Toro Hydro holds 80% and AES Panama 20%, and The AES Corporation reported owning 89.8% of it directly or through subsidiaries as at the end of 2014.

sources.title: AES Changuinola, S.R.L. annual financial report for the year ended 31 December 2014

AES Corp..desc: A US-based global power company. It owns electricity generation, utilities and LNG infrastructure, with solar, hydro, wind, gas, coal and battery storage plants; it reported 34.7 GW of generating capacity in operation and revenue of $12.2 billion in 2025.

sources.title: About Us

AES Levant Jordan.desc: A Jordanian project company, AES Levant Holding BV Jordan PSC, incorporated in Jordan solely to build and operate the 250 MW IPP4 power plant, which runs on 16 diesel engines. It is owned by AES Baltic Holdings B.V. and Mitsui & Company Ltd.

sources.title: IPP4 Al-Manakher Power Project: Non-Technical Summary

No company register entry or company page found; left blank rather than attribute AES Corporation facts to this name.

AMA.desc: Rome's municipal environmental services company (Azienda Municipalizzata Ambiente), owned by the municipality of Rome, which collects and processes household waste and runs recycling facilities. It employed about 6,000 workers at the time of a 1999 reorganisation that split it into a holding company and a collection company.

sources.title: Unions divided over flexibility and reorganisation of Rome's environmental services

ANZ.desc: An Australian bank, listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, with its registered office at ANZ Centre, 833 Collins Street, Docklands, Melbourne. It provides banking and financial products to more than 10 million customers in close to 30 markets, and reported total assets of A$1,229,115 million and 42,370 full-time-equivalent staff as at 30 September 2024. ANZ Group Holdings Limited is its authorised non-operating holding company.

The EBRD project documents and the EIB Complaints Mechanism report on the Kharkiv metro extension discuss the valuations but no opened page describes the firm itself (legal form, registration, ownership or size). Left blank rather than guess.

Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company.desc: A sovereign investment company and stated strategic partner of the Government of Abu Dhabi, investing in infrastructure and supply chains. As at 31 December 2024 it reported more than 25 portfolio companies in seven clusters, including energy and utilities, food and agriculture, healthcare, financial services, and transport and logistics, operating in more than 130 markets.

sources.title: ADQ Sustainable Investing Report 2024-2025

Adani Ports and SEZ / Adani Power.desc: Two listed Indian companies in the Adani Group, founded by Gautam Adani and based in Ahmedabad. Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited runs ports, marine services, logistics and special economic zone land, handling about 450 million tonnes of cargo and about Rs 31,079 crore of revenue in the 2024-25 financial year across 15 domestic and four international ports; Adani Power Limited is India's largest private-sector thermal power producer, with 17,550 MW of operating capacity.

Adaro Power.desc: The power generation arm of Indonesia's AlamTri Resources Indonesia Tbk, formerly Adaro Energy Indonesia, a coal producer. It holds coal-fired generation interests including 65% of PT Tanjung Power Indonesia (2x100 MW, South Kalimantan) alongside Korea East-West Power's Indonesian subsidiary, and a consortium share with J-Power and Itochu in PT Bhimasena Power Indonesia's 2x1,000 MW plant at Batang, Central Java.

sources.title: Power
sources.publisher: AlamTri Resources Indonesia Tbk (formerly Adaro Energy Indonesia)

Addax Bioenergy (Addax & Oryx Group).desc: A sugarcane bioethanol and renewable electricity operation at Makeni, Sierra Leone, formerly majority-owned by the Addax & Oryx Group (AOG). In October 2016 AOG transferred 75.1% of the company to a group of investors led by Sunbird Bioenergy Africa Limited and kept a 24.9% minority stake.

sources.title: AOG hands over 75.1% of Addax Bioenergy to Sunbird Bioenergy

Adriatic Metals PLC.desc: A mining company registered in England that owned the Vares underground silver-lead-zinc-gold mine in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It no longer exists under that name: Dundee Precious Metals completed its acquisition on 3 September 2025, and the company was renamed DPM BH Holdings Limited later that month.

sources.title: DPM BH HOLDINGS LIMITED, company number 10599833 (previous names)
Dundee Precious Metals completes acquisition of Adriatic Metals

Adventus Mining.desc: A Canadian mineral exploration and development company whose properties were in Ecuador, chiefly a 75% interest in the El Domo copper-gold project and 98.7% of the Condor gold project. It no longer exists independently: Silvercorp Metals Inc. completed its acquisition of Adventus on 31 July 2024.

sources.title: Silvercorp Metals Inc. Form 6-K, condensed consolidated financial statements

Aempire Resource Ltd.note: Searched for Aempire Resource Ltd as a Hong Kong company and as parent of PT Mikgro Metal Perdana. No Hong Kong company registry entry, HKEX filing, company page or news report describing the firm could be found or opened; the one trade report retrieved (Petromindo on a Hong Kong firm acquiring Bengkulu iron ore mines) names a different company. Found only Brazilian coverage of the Nova Atlantida resort project itself and unrelated later Ceara hotel developments; no company register entry, company page or news item describing either firm's business, ownership or size could be opened. Left blank.

African Investment Group (AIG).desc: A Senegalese company based in Dakar that holds licences to phosphate rock and ilmenite sand deposits in Senegal. Poland's Grupa Azoty Zaklady Chemiczne "Police" S.A., a fertilizer producer, bought a 55% controlling stake in August 2013 for $28.85 million; its phosphate mining output was targeted to double to 200,000 tonnes a year in 2014.

sources.title: Police with its own deposits of phosphate rock in Senegal
Poland's ZChP aims to double phosphate mining output in Senegal

African Parks.desc: A protected-area management organisation founded in 2000 that takes on long-term management of national parks and reserves under public-private partnership agreements with African governments. In 2025 it managed 24 protected areas in 13 African countries, covering more than 20 million hectares, and employed over 6,000 people.

sources.title: African Parks 2025 Annual Report

Agrica / Kilombero Plantations Ltd.desc: Kilombero Plantations Ltd (KPL) is a Tanzanian commercial rice farming company running the 5,818-hectare Mngeta farm, which it bought in 2008 from the Rufiji Basin Development Authority. It is 97.54% owned by Agrica Tanzania Ltd, itself wholly owned by Agrica Limited of Britain, with 2.46% held by the Rufiji Basin Development Authority; Agrica was founded in 2005 and its investors include Capricorn Investment Group, Norway's Norfund and the UK's AgDevCo.

sources.title: Kilombero Plantations Limited: Responsible Agricultural Investment
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

Agrium (now Nutrien).desc: A Canadian crop inputs and services company. It no longer exists under that name: on 2 January 2018 it merged with Potash Corporation of Saskatchewan to form Nutrien Ltd., which trades on the Toronto and New York stock exchanges as NTR and supplied 27.5 million tonnes of fertilizer to customers in more than 50 countries in 2025.

sources.title: Agrium and PotashCorp Merger Completed, Forming Nutrien, a Leader in Global Agriculture
News Releases / company overview

Agrokasa (Sociedad Agrícola Drokasa).desc: A Peruvian farming company that grows, packs and ships avocados, table grapes, blueberries and asparagus from farms in Ica and Barranca on the central coast. It began as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Peruvian group Corporacion Drokasa; in 2023 the Guatemalan agro-industrial group Grupo HAME agreed to buy 100% of it.

sources.title: Sociedad Agricola Drokasa S.A. - Summary of Project Information
Peruvian Agrokasa sells to Grupo HAME

AirScan, Inc..desc: A US security and aerial surveillance contractor based in Florida. From 1997 it provided security for Occidental Petroleum's oil pipeline in Colombia.

sources.title: Mujica v. AirScan, Inc., No. 10-55515 (9th Cir. 2014)
sources.publisher: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit (via Justia)

Akiira Geothermal Limited (AGL).desc: A Kenyan project company, based in Karen, Nairobi, set up to develop geothermal power in Naivasha Sub-County, Nakuru County. It is jointly owned by Centum Investments Company Limited and Frontier Energy, with Marine Power Generation Limited and Ram Energy Inc. as development partners, and planned up to 140 MW net in two phases as of February 2023.

sources.title: Stakeholder Engagement Plan for Akiira Geothermal Limited
sources.publisher: Akiira Geothermal Limited (via Business & Human Rights Resource Centre)

Alamos Gold.desc: A Canadian gold mining company based in Toronto and listed on the Toronto and New York stock exchanges as AGI, with producing mines in Canada (Island Gold and Young-Davidson) and Mexico (the Mulatos district). It produced 567,000 ounces of gold and reported operating revenues of $1,346.9 million in 2024.

sources.title: Alamos Gold Inc. investor information
Alamos Gold Reports Fourth Quarter and Year-End 2024 Results (Form 6-K exhibit)

Alcoa / Suralco.desc: Alcoa Corporation is a producer of bauxite, alumina and aluminium, incorporated in Delaware and trading on the New York Stock Exchange as "AA" since November 2016, when it was separated from Alcoa Inc.; its combined sales were $11.2 billion in 2015. Suralco (Suriname Aluminum Company) held its Suriname alumina refinery and bauxite mines through the AWAC group, 60% owned by Alcoa and 40% by Australia's Alumina Limited; Alcoa approved the refinery's permanent closure on 30 December 2016.

sources.title: Alcoa Corporation Form S-1

Alfa Gold Corp DMCC.desc: A gold trading company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It wholly owns Alfa Gold Corp Ltd, a London-registered company, and is a sister company of Alfa Gold in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of Congo.

sources.title: River of Gold: How the state lost out in an eastern Congolese gold boom

Alpart.desc: Alumina Partners of Jamaica, an alumina refinery complex in Jamaica fed by its own bauxite mines, with an annual capacity of 1.65 million tonnes of smelter-grade alumina and 4.9 million tonnes of bauxite before operations were suspended from 2009 to 2015. UC RUSAL sold its 100% stake to the Chinese state industrial group Jiuquan Iron & Steel (JISCO) for $299 million, completed on 22 November 2016.

sources.title: RUSAL completes the sale of Alpart alumina refinery in Jamaica

Altain Khuder LLC.desc: A Mongolian mining company that developed and operates the Tayan Nuur iron ore mine in Tseel soum, Gobi-Altai province, on a 162-hectare licence area, trucking ore to the Chinese border at Burgastai. In January 2012 the EBRD approved up to $30 million in debt and up to $25 million in equity for the company.

sources.title: When the dust settles: EBRD's Altain Khuder iron ore mine in Mongolia

Amara Mining plc (formerly Cluff Gold pl.desc: A West African gold mining company registered in England, whose shares traded on London's AIM market under the ticker AMA. It was incorporated in July 2003 as Energybold plc, was named Cluff Gold plc from 2004 to 2012 and Amara Mining plc from 2012; Perseus Mining took it over under a scheme of arrangement sanctioned by the High Court in April 2016, and it is now the private company Amara Mining Limited.

Ambatovy (Sherritt, Sumitomo, Korea Reso.desc: A nickel mining and refining operation in Madagascar whose products are listed on the London Metal Exchange. Canada's Dynatec took full ownership in 2005 and was joined in 2006 by SNC-Lavalin (5%), Korea Resources Corporation (27.5%) and Sumitomo (27.5%); Sherritt bought Dynatec in 2007 and became operator, reduced its share in 2017 and exited in 2020, while Sumitomo transferred its entire stake to UK-based Ambatovy Mineral Resources Investment Holding Company in 2026.

sources.title: History of the project

Anagold Madencilik.desc: A Turkish gold mining company established in 2000 that operates the Copler gold mine in Erzincan province, where it poured its first gold in December 2010. It is a partnership of Cengiz Holding and Lidya Madencilik and employs 2,700 people in its mining operation.

sources.title: About Us

Anglo American (through Anmercosa Mining.desc: Anglo American plc is a global mining company headquartered in London and listed in London and Johannesburg; Anmercosa Mining West Africa was one of its subsidiaries. AngloGold Ashanti plc is a gold miner incorporated in England and Wales and tax resident in the UK, with its global headquarters in Denver, Colorado and a corporate office in Johannesburg; its shares have their primary listing on the New York Stock Exchange, with secondary listings on the Johannesburg, A2X and Ghana exchanges, and its mines and projects are in the DRC, Egypt, Ghana, Guinea, Tanzania, Cote d'Ivoire, Argentina, Brazil, Australia, the United States and Colombia. The group reorganised under AngloGold Ashanti plc in September 2023, the former parent being renamed AngloGold Ashanti (Pty) Ltd.

AngloGold Ashanti plc Form 20-F for the year ended 31 December 2024

Anglo American Platinum / Potgietersrust.desc: A South African producer of platinum group metals that mines, smelts and refines platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium and ruthenium plus nickel, copper and chrome concentrate, with about 28,000 employees and contractors. It was renamed Valterra Platinum in 2025 when Anglo American plc completed its demerger on 31 May 2025, keeping about 19.9%; it is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange with a secondary London listing.

Anglo American completes demerger of Valterra Platinum

Anglo American plc.desc: A global mining company headquartered in London and listed on the London and Johannesburg stock exchanges. Its stated focus is copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients; it also lists nickel, manganese, diamonds and steelmaking coal among current products, with several of those businesses being sold or separated.

sources.title: At a glance

Anglo Asian Mining.desc: A gold, copper and silver mining company with production and exploration sites in Azerbaijan, held under a production sharing agreement with the Azerbaijan government dated 20 August 1997. Its main site is Gedabek; it reported revenue of $39.6 million and 15,073 ounces of gold in 2024, and employs nearly 1,000 people. It is registered in England as a public limited company (incorporated 2004, registered office in London).

Anhui Conch Cement Co., Ltd..desc: A Chinese cement maker that produces and sells clinker, cement, aggregates and ready-mixed concrete, and also runs waste-treatment and solar power businesses. Its A shares trade in Shanghai (600585) and H shares in Hong Kong (00914); its controlling shareholder is Anhui Conch Holdings with 36.40%, and the Anhui provincial government's state asset commission is the ultimate controller. Revenue was RMB 91.0 billion in 2024, with 268 million tonnes of self-produced cement and clinker sold.

Anjin Investments.desc: A diamond mining company in Zimbabwe's Marange fields, held 50-50 by China's Anhui Foreign Economic Construction (Group) Co. Ltd and the Zimbabwean company Matt Bronze Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd. Matt Bronze was formed by the Ministry of Defence/Zimbabwe Defence Forces and the Zimbabwe Mining Development Corporation through Glass Finish (Pvt) Ltd, which is 80% military-owned and 20% ZMDC-owned.

sources.title: An Inside Job: Zimbabwe - The state, the security forces, and a decade of disappearing diamonds

Antea Cement.desc: An Albanian cement company that owns and runs a cement plant at Boka e Kuqe near Kruja with a capacity of about 1.5 million tonnes of cement a year, built for about EUR 200 million and inaugurated in September 2010. It is part of the Titan Cement Group, with the EBRD and the IFC also shareholders.

Apex Silver Mines.desc: A silver mining company that developed the San Cristobal mine in Bolivia. It no longer exists: it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in January 2009, sold its interest in San Cristobal to Sumitomo, and its remaining assets passed to a successor company, Golden Minerals Company, incorporated in Delaware in March 2009.

sources.title: Golden Minerals Company Form 10-K for fiscal year 2009

Aracruz Celulose.desc: A Brazilian eucalyptus pulp producer that sold almost all of its output for export and held a 50% stake in the Veracel pulp joint venture in southern Bahia. It no longer exists: in 2009 it was acquired by and merged into Votorantim Celulose e Papel, which was renamed Fibria Celulose S.A.

Areva (Orano).desc: A French nuclear fuel cycle group covering uranium mining, conversion and enrichment, used fuel recycling, nuclear logistics, dismantling and nuclear medicine. Areva was split and recapitalised in 2017, and the fuel cycle company New Areva was renamed Orano in January 2018, when it reported about EUR 4 billion in revenue and 16,000 employees; the reactor business was sold and renamed Framatome. As at 31 December 2024 the French state held 90.33% of Orano, with Japan's JNFL and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries holding 4.83% each.

Asia World.desc: A Burmese conglomerate founded in 1992 by Lo Hsing Han and run by his son Steven Law as managing director, which has received government concessions to build ports, highways and government facilities. Its subsidiaries include Asia World Port Management, Asia World Industries Ltd and Asia World Light Ltd. The US Treasury designated the company under Executive Order 13448 on 25 February 2010.

Atiaia Energia.desc: A Brazilian electricity generator, also known as Atiaia Renovaveis, that develops, builds and operates small hydroelectric, wind and solar projects. It is a joint venture of the Cornelio Brennand Group (90%) and Koblitz Energia (10%).

sources.title: Atiaia Energia S.A. company profile

Aureus Mining (renamed Avesoro Resources.desc: A West African gold producer listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and London's AIM, whose main asset was the New Liberty Gold Mine in Liberia on the Bea Mountain mining licence, with proven and probable reserves of 8.5 million tonnes containing 924,000 ounces of gold. Shareholders approved renaming it Avesoro Resources Inc. in late 2016, when Turkey's MNG acquired the company.

Aurul S.A. (Esmeralda Exploration and Ro.desc: A Romanian stock company, established in 1992 and jointly owned by Esmeralda Exploration Limited of Australia and the Romanian state mining company REMIN. It reprocessed old mine waste near Baia Mare to recover gold and silver using a cyanide carbon-in-pulp process, designed for 2.5 million tonnes a year and about 1.6 tonnes of gold and 9.0 tonnes of silver annually, and began operating in May 1999.

B2Gold.desc: A Canadian gold mining company headquartered in Vancouver and listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (BTO), NYSE American (BTG) and the Namibian Stock Exchange (B2G). It operates the Fekola mine in Mali (80% owned), Masbate in the Philippines and Otjikoto in Namibia (90%), and produced 804,778 ounces of gold in 2024.

sources.title: B2Gold Reports Fourth Quarter 2024 Gold Production and 2025 Guidance

BASF.desc: A German chemical company organised in six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Nutrition & Care, Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. Sales were EUR 65.3 billion in 2024, with 111,822 employees at year-end.

sources.title: BASF Report 2024: 2024 at a glance

BBVA Previsión AFP and Futuro de Bolivia.desc: The two private pension fund administrators (AFPs) set up in Bolivia after a 1997 international tender, each a company whose only business was managing pension funds. BBVA held 80% of BBVA Previsión AFP, incorporated in Bolivia in February 1997 and licensed that April for the country's southeast; Futuro de Bolivia S.A. AFP was created by the Invesco-Argentaria consortium for the northwest, with Argentaria as majority shareholder, and BBVA sold its stake in Futuro in March 2001.

BOTAŞ.desc: Turkey's state-owned pipeline and gas company (Boru Hatlari ile Petrol Tasima A.S.), set up on 15 August 1974 to carry Iraqi crude oil to Iskenderun Bay. It runs crude oil and natural gas pipelines, LNG and FSRU terminals, port services and gas storage, and trades natural gas and LNG.

BP Exploration Company (Colombia).desc: BP's oil and gas exploration, production and transportation business in Colombia, holding interests in five producing fields (including Cusiana, Pauto and Florena), a stake in the Cusiana gas processing plant, interests in four pipelines and 24.8% of the OCENSA crude oil pipeline, with net production of about 25,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. In 2010 Ecopetrol (51%) and Canada's Talisman (49%) agreed to buy 100% of its shares for $1.9 billion.

BSES (Bombay Suburban Electric Supply).desc: An Indian electricity company that supplied power over its own network, chaired by Anil Ambani. It no longer uses that name: shareholders voted in June 2003 to rename it Reliance Energy Ltd, alongside plans for wholly owned transmission and electricity trading subsidiaries.

sources.title: BSES renamed Reliance Energy

BTC Co (BP-led consortium).desc: A separately incorporated company formed in August 2002 to build and run the 1,768 km Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan oil pipeline from Azerbaijan through Georgia and Turkey to the Ceyhan Marine Terminal, with capacity of one million barrels of oil a day. Its shareholders are BP (30.1%), AzBTC (25.00%), MOL (8.90%), Equinor (8.71%), TPAO (6.53%), Eni (5.00%), Total (5.00%), ITOCHU (3.40%), INPEX (2.50%), ExxonMobil (2.50%) and ONGC (BTC) Limited (2.36%).

sources.title: Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline

Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.desc: An Indian state-owned special purpose vehicle, a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Karnataka, which builds and operates the Bengaluru Metro Rail project (Namma Metro). Its operating network is 96.10 km across three corridors.

sources.title: About Us
Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) profile

Bangladesh Water Development Board.desc: The Bangladeshi government's main water management agency, under the Ministry of Water Resources and governed by the BWDB Act 2000. It began in 1959 as the water wing of the East Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority and was reconstituted as a separate autonomous body in 1972; it builds and maintains flood control, drainage and irrigation works, and had built 10,224 km of embankments as of the 2008-09 financial year.

Bangladesh-China Power Company (BCPCL).desc: A Bangladeshi joint venture company incorporated on 1 October 2014 to build and run power projects, chiefly the 1,320 MW Payra coal-fired plant at Dhankhali, Patuakhali. It is owned 50-50 by North-West Power Generation Company Limited, a Bangladeshi state enterprise, and China National Machinery Import & Export Corporation, a wholly Chinese state-owned company.
